messages:
elena (product): @channel Rolling out Hosted API streaming + tool/function-calls to GA today. This release is focused on stability, clearer billing for streams, and better integrator ergonomics. Please skim the notes and ping product if you want an early tenant opt-out.

naveen (eng-runtime): High level: same /v1/generate path, new `stream` modes. We added both SSE and WebSocket support. No breaking change to sync calls. Recommended model for general-purpose low-latency workloads: `redwood-serve-3.2`. SDKs with native helpers: js v1.0.0+, py v1.0.0+. Example WebSocket handshake (JS):

```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-serve-3.2', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}` } });
ws.onmessage = (e) => console.log('chunk', e.data);
```

sam (eng-sre): Rollout plan: canary began 09:30 UTC for internal + paid customers flagged for early-access. Global enablement will continue region-by-region over the next 6 hours. Per-tenant throttle default = 25 rps. If you see a regression, add `x-redwood-pinned-model: <variant>` to your requests and open a ticket; we can rollback at tenant scope.

arun (platform): Policy/billing changes to note (customer-facing): streaming still billed per token, but were adding a small per-connection minute surcharge for connections that exceed 2 minutes to cover proxy resources. Internal rate = $0.0006/min after minute 2 for long lived streams. This is in the migration doc and will show in billing previews.

elena (product): Migration checklist we pushed to docs: 1) confirm tool schema (v1) for tool results, 2) upgrade SDKs to v1.0.0+, 3) validate retry semantics (idempotency keys supported), 4) test with the `stream=false` fallback. Note: tool invocations require newline-delimited JSON and strict content-type `application/x-ndjson`.

liz (marketing): Marketing schedule: blog + docs update at 16:00 PT, banner in Console the same day. Sales & CS will get a one-pager and suggested support replies. Product, can someone drop 2 short quotes + one screenshot in #marketing by 11:30?

deploy-bot: rollout finished for hosted-runtime v3.13.1 -> us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1/ap-south1. Canary tag: hosted-runtime-canary-2026-04-25-0930.

naveen (eng-runtime): Integrator tips: watch headers `X-Redwood-Stream: yes` and `X-Tool-Call-Id`. WebSocket sends chunk frames with `event: chunk` and finalization with `event: done`. Tools must emit `status` fields and follow the NDJSON contract or we will reject with 422.

sam (eng-sre): Observability: dashboards created: Console -> Observability -> Streaming. New alerts: streaming-latency-p95 > 600ms for 10m and streaming-error-rate > 1.5% for 5m. Those will page eng-oncall.

elena (product): Customer-facing nuance: streaming changes small token accounting differences for mid-stream cancellation. We documented examples and a conversion table. Also added an opt-out tenant flag for customers who want to avoid per-connection billing while they test.

jen (ceo): Big thanks to everyone who shipped this. Important milestone for product parity across hosted/dedicated/private. Excited to see customer integrations. :rocket:
